subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three guard assertions are corrected, should OpenClaw accept this exact grouped set of privileged GitHub Action revisions?
rationale: The revisions mint installation tokens, execute Codex with API credentials, upload security results, and publish container artifacts; repository automation cannot safely choose that supply-chain boundary without owner intent and direct source review.

options.title: Approve after guarded source review
options.body: Review the exact upstream revisions, update all matching digest assertions, and merge only after exact-head workflow-security checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Land low-privilege setup updates separately and review token, Codex, scanning, and publishing actions in narrower pull requests.

options.title: Pause the grouped upgrade
options.body: Keep the existing pinned revisions until a reviewer can complete direct upstream and Codex-source inspection.

recommendation.title: Approve after guarded source review
recommendation.body: Review the exact upstream revisions, update all matching digest assertions, and merge only after exact-head workflow-security checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the only human explicitly routed into the supplied PR timeline for the security-sensitive workflow update.
